summary: Vale S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K announcing only the scheduling of its third-quarter 2026 results release for October 29, 2026, after market close, with a conference call and webcast on October 30, 2026 at 11:00 Brasília / 10:00 New York / 14:00 London, conducted in English with Portuguese translation. The filing notes that beginning in 3Q26 Vale will consolidate operational, sales and financial information into its Performance Report, absorbing the former separate Production and Sales Report. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or structural mechanic is disclosed. No special-situation or risk-arb angle applies.
